min_standing_note.value: Minimum cumulative GPA equivalent to 3.00 on a 4.3 grading scale; undergraduate applicants must have completed at least one semester and graduate applicants at least one semester of graduate studies prior to arrival.

min_gpa_host.notes: Concordia publishes a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 on a 4.30 grading scale (https://www.concordia.ca/international/students-from-abroad/inbound-exchange/how-to-apply.html); left null here rather than converting across the 4.0 vs 4.3 scale.

instruction_languages.notes: English is the primary language of instruction.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Non-English-medium applicants must meet direct-admission English proficiency (no ESL/conditional admission): UG baseline TOEFL iBT 70 (4.0 on revised scale) or IELTS Academic 6.0 (min 5.5 component); GR/MBA often higher (e.g., TOEFL 95 with min 20 section / IELTS 7.0 with min 6.5). No RHET 1020 exemption stated.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: Inbound exchange rule confirmed at https://www.concordia.ca/international/students-from-abroad/inbound-exchange/how-to-apply.html; graduate standards via https://www.concordia.ca/graduatestudies/admissions/international/english-language-proficiency.html.

host_language_requirement.value: English proficiency required (see english_proficiency_and_rhet1020); French not required for standard English-medium exchange coursework.

available_terms.notes: Fall/Spring (AUC Spring maps to Concordia's Winter term, January–May).

spring_term_dates.value: 2027-01-11 to 2027-05-02 (Winter term: classes Jan 11–Apr 12; final exams Apr 15–May 2, 2027)

tuition_model.notes: Official partner exchange students pay regular tuition to their home university and study tuition-free at Concordia (exempt from international differential tuition).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Sum of published monthly off-campus budget components ($1,100 housing/rent + $450 food + $63 student transit + $408 personal/phone from cost-of-living.html & https://www.concordia.ca/admissions/undergraduate/costs-aid.html), excluding books (~$2,800+/yr). Comparable to Quebec immigration 12-month living estimate of CAD $24,617/yr (~CAD $2,051/mo) on https://www.concordia.ca/students/international/immigration/study-permits/estimate-costs.html.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate: 2,021 CAD/month * 5 months = 10,105 CAD * 0.701358 USD/CAD = 7,087.22 USD (ECB 2026-11-13 cross rate 1 EUR = 1.5758 CAD and 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD -> 1 CAD = 0.701358 USD, collected 2026-11-15: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Compulsory Blue Cross international health insurance (2026-2027 rates): CAD $388 (4-month term), CAD $873 (9-month Fall & Winter), or CAD $1,164 (12-month).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Inbound exchange health insurance FAQ at https://www.concordia.ca/international/students-from-abroad/inbound-exchange/faq/health-insurance.html.

housing_availability.notes: University housing portal and off-campus living guidance provided; most inbound exchange students budget for off-campus Montreal apartments (~CAD $1,100/month).

housing_notes.value: Residence and off-campus housing resources via Concordia Housing; estimated off-campus rent and utilities ~CAD $1,100/month.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: One-semester stays (<6 months) generally require only a visitor visa (TRV) or eTA; stays >6 months (full-year) require a Quebec CAQ and Canadian Study Permit with proof of CAD $24,617/year in living funds (plus insurance).

course_catalog_url.notes: Graduate calendar at http://www.concordia.ca/academics/graduate/calendar.html (extracted from AY2022_23 fact sheet).

english_course_list_url.notes: Instruction is primarily in English across all calendars; no separate English-only filter URL required.

credit_system_and_load.value: North American credit hours (standard course = 3 credits). UG load: 12–15 credits/term (4–5 courses); GR load: 8–9 credits/term (2–3 courses), or 12 credits for MBA.

course_restrictions_note.value: Fine Arts and Creative Writing require a password-free web portfolio; graduate/MBA course access restricted to graduate exchange nominations.

value: Incoming Exchange Application form (issued after partner nomination)
List of courses currently in progress
Proof of English language proficiency (if applicable)
Portfolio (Fine Arts/Creative Writing) or CV/degree certificates (Graduate/MBA)

campus_type.notes: Operates two Montreal campuses: Sir George Williams (downtown) and Loyola.

international_support_services.value: Concordia International inbound exchange advising, International Students Office (ISO) immigration/health-insurance support, and housing assistance.

nomination_deadlines.value: Annual inbound application deadline: April 1 (covers Fall, Full-Year, and Winter terms; prior partner nomination required).
